h1: Custom Kids Umbrellas for Fun & Safety
metaDescription: Order custom kids umbrellas for events, schools, or safety kits. Fun designs, durable construction, and bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom kids umbrellas turn rainy days into opportunities for brand visibility. Unlike adult umbrellas, children's versions feature smaller frames, rounded tips, and vibrant colors that appeal to young users. Whether you're outfitting a school safety program or creating a giveaway for a family-friendly event, these umbrellas combine durability with kid-safe design. Choose from stick or collapsible styles, and add your logo via screen printing or digital transfer for a lasting impression.
heroAltText: A group of colorful custom kids umbrellas with printed logos, featuring safety rounded tips and durable frames
